# Load data
```{r, eval=TRUE}

all.sample.info <- read.csv(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "vcf_data", "all.sample.info.csv"), sep=";", header=FALSE)
dim(all.sample.info)
rownames(all.sample.info) <-  rownames(all.sample.info)

## Read data
wRI.pooldata=vcf2pooldata(vcf.file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "vcf_data", "wRI.filtered.vcf.gz"), poolsizes = all.sample.info[,2],poolnames = rownames(all.sample.info))


```
